nat_induction: (h0 h1 : Nat) (h2 : Nat.succ h0 + h1 = Nat.succ (h0 + h1)) | Nat.succ h0 + Nat.succ h1 = Nat.succ (h0 + Nat.succ h1)
list_induction: (h0 h1 : Type) (h2 : h0 → h1) (h4 : List h0) | List.map h2 (([] : List h0) ++ h4) = List.map h2 [] ++ List.map h2 h4

(h0 h1 : Type) (h2 : h0 → h1) (h4 : List h0) (h5 : h0) (h6 : List h0) (h7 : List.map h2 (h6 ++ h4) = List.map h2 h6 ++ List.map h2 h4) | List.map h2 ((h5 :: h6) ++ h4) = List.map h2 (h5 :: h6) ++ List.map h2 h4
list_exists: (h0 : Type) (h1 : h0) (h2 : List h0) | ∃ ys : List h0, List.length ys = Nat.succ (List.length h2) ∧ List.tail ys = h2
tree_induction: (h0 : Type) (h3 h4 : PilotTree h0) (h5 : PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h3) = PilotTree.nodes h3) (h6 : PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h4) = PilotTree.nodes h4) | 1 + (PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h4) + PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h3)) = 1 + (PilotTree.nodes h3 + PilotTree.nodes h4)
